warrior: Strong broad-shouldered medieval veteran warrior, black beard, steel and chainmail, chest-up painterly portrait, warm rim light and dark blue background, no text.
assets: Use case: stylized-concept. A single horizontal medieval fantasy game UI banner, 3:1 aspect ratio. Rich royal blue woven silk with broad empty middle for a player name overlaid by game code, ornate aged gold trim, curled cloth ends, slight realistic folds, hand-painted fantasy strategy artwork. Symmetrical front view, isolated on transparent background, no letters, no text, no watermark. Banner fills most image width.

Use case: stylized-concept. Seamless square top-down terrain texture for a painted medieval fantasy strategy map. Marsh variation 1 of six: shallow teal pools and small scattered golden cattails. Small-scale terrain details evenly distributed edge to edge, calm muted blue-green water and ochre reeds, plainly a wet marsh. No bushes, no trees, no forest canopy, no buildings, no horizon, no hex outline, no text or border. Natural painted ground texture that blends with adjacent tiles.
